name: Paper Minecraft
description: High-performance Minecraft server (PaperMC). Includes EULA handling and server.properties.
installScript:
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl jq >/dev/null
MC_VERSION=${MC_VERSION:-latest}
if [ "$MC_VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
  MC_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper | jq -r '.versions[-1]')
fi
BUILD=$(curl -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/$MC_VERSION/builds | jq -r '.builds[-1].build')
echo "Downloading Paper $MC_VERSION build $BUILD"
curl -s -o paper.jar "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/$MC_VERSION/builds/$BUILD/downloads/paper-$MC_VERSION-$BUILD.jar"
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt

configs.content:
server-ip=
server-port={{SERVER_PORT}}
motd={{MOTD}}
max-players=20
online-mode=true
view-distance=10
enable-command-block=false
